expectations.evidence: Bulk summary contains record, priority, persona, fit, low-confidence, open-question, and review counts.
expectations.text: The bulk run summary processes 8 records and includes research priority distribution, persona distribution, fit distribution, low-confidence count, open-question count, and records needing review.
Every fixture row is assigned the expected persona, score, and fit label from the Northstar lead fixture.

expectations.evidence: Compact CSV header includes every required research and provenance field.
expectations.text: The compact CSV output includes lead_id, account_id, account_name, lead_name, title, persona_label, score, fit_label, research_priority, confidence, needs_review, reasoning, lead_research_brief, role_relevance, likely_priorities, account_context, personalization_angles, recommended_next_step, top_evidence, and open_questions.

expectations.evidence: No-match rows are low-priority; Anika Shah is review-gated.
expectations.text: The two no-match rows use research_priority low, and Anika Shah is low confidence with needs_review true.

expectations.evidence: Ephemeral bulk run left git status clean: <clean>.
expectations.text: The bulk output remains ephemeral and performs no durable write, git commit, CRM update, outreach, campaign trigger, sync, or remote push.
